population_banner:
POPULATION: this projection covers 281 declared ET-CC members and 173
declared in-population OC checks. That is the slice adjudicated so far,
and it is NOT the whole conformance picture: the full comparison is 281
ET-CC members and 173 in-denominator OC checks, of which 0 members and 0
checks are not_yet_adjudicated -- a third state, distinct from bucket 1
-- owned by the tickets the crosswalk's own `outside_the_population`
block names. A further 0 checks carry an edge without being declared by
any file, so they are counted in neither.

A count of zero in this view means zero WITHIN THAT SLICE. It does not
mean zero in the suite. As the declared population grows this projection
re-runs and fills.

EVERY FIGURE ABOVE IS INTERPOLATED from the crosswalk being projected;
none is written here. The [population_statement] guard refuses a
population figure that is not.
predicate: CITATION, not a projection. The in-scope OC checks A5 (MES-70) classified `matchable: false` in `docs/conformance/bucket-0-2026-07-28.json`. Universe: the 175 checks of A1's manifest. They were removed from the denominator BEFORE the join — the crosswalk is built against 173 checks — so they appear in no cell and cannot be filtered out of one.
